# Tin tức Bitcoin hôm nay (10/11/2026)

**Giá và diễn biến chính**

- Bitcoin giao dịch quanh **$74.200–74.260**, giảm khoảng 1,4% trong ngày và mất khoảng $31.700 so với cùng kỳ năm trước. Vốn hóa thị trường khoảng **$1,33 nghìn tỷ** (Fortune, Bitcoin Foundation).
- BTC chạm **đáy 11 tuần ở $73.588** sau khi CPI tháng 10 của Mỹ tăng 0,4% so với tháng 9, cao hơn dự báo 0,3% (Quartz).

**Vĩ mô tác động**

- CPI lõi tăng 0,3%, khiến khả năng Fed tăng lãi suất trong cuộc họp 8–9/12 được thị trường định giá tới **84,4%** — yếu tố thường gây áp lực lên tài sản rủi ro như Bitcoin (Bitcoin Foundation).
- Lợi suất trái phiếu 2 năm tăng 14 điểm cơ bản lên 4,69%; hợp đồng Nasdaq 100 giảm 1,2% (Quartz).

**Dòng tiền và tổ chức**

- **Hyperscale Data** đã bán nốt 211,56 BTC (~$16 triệu) tính đến 8/11, nâng tổng lượng bán từ cuối tháng 7 lên khoảng **1.113 BTC**, để tài trợ cho trung tâm dữ liệu AI 10 MW tại Michigan (Bitcoin Magazine).
- **Strategy (MSTR)** đang nắm ~850.000 BTC với giá vốn bình quân ~$75.456 — cao hơn giá thị trường hiện tại, khiến việc mua thêm chậm lại do mất phần bù giá cổ phiếu (Trefis).

**Dự báo trái chiều**

- **I/O Fund** vẫn giữ mục tiêu dài hạn **$2 triệu/BTC**, nhưng cảnh báo giá có thể giảm về **$30.000–40.000** trước (Yahoo Finance).
- **Trefis** đặt câu hỏi về khả năng hồi lên $125.000, lưu ý biên độ tăng sau mỗi chu kỳ halving đang thu hẹp dần (30x → 8x → dưới 2x).

**Nguồn tham khảo**
- Fortune: https://fortune.com/article/price-of-bitcoin-11-10-2026
- Quartz: https://qz.com/bitcoin-11-week-low-october-inflation-fed-rate-hike-111026
- Bitcoin Foundation: https://bitcoinfoundation.org/news/bitcoin/bitcoin-december-fed-hike-odds-reach-84-as-equity-funds-draw-266b
- Bitcoin Magazine: https://bitcoinmagazine.com/news/hyperscale-data-sells-last-bitcoin-ai
- Yahoo Finance: https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/crypto/articles/bitcoin-2m-investment-firm-backs-102447422.html
- Trefis: https://www.trefis.com/stock/mstr/articles/623857/can-bitcoin-bounce-back-to-125-000/2026-11-10

items.summary:

# Bitcoin falls to an 11-week low after hotter-than-expected October inflation

Consumer prices rose 0.4% in October and core prices rose 0.3%, ahead of the Federal Reserve's Dec. 8-9 meeting

Bitcoin falls to an 11-week low after hotter-than-expected October inflation [...] The data make additional Fed rate hikes look more likely, a development that tends to pressure riskier holdings, according to The Wall Street Journal. U.S. stock index futures slid once the report landed, with Nasdaq $NDAQ 100 contracts losing 1.2% and S&P 500 contracts shedding 0.5%. The 2-year Treasury yield rose 14 basis points to 4.69%. Traders are pricing a small chance of a 50-basis-point move in December, according to CoinDesk.

items.title: Bitcoin to $2M? Investment Firm Backs Huge Target but Warns of $30K Crash First
items.summary:
Bitcoin could eventually reach $2 million, according to I/O Fund — but the investment research firm warns that its next major move could first take it toward $30,000.

Technical portfolio manager Knox Ridley's Nov. 6 analysis maintains the firm's bullish long-term outlook while outlining two clear paths to a deeper decline.

## Bitcoin Could Fall to $30K — or Rally Before Reversing [...] At $2 million per coin, BTC would have a fully diluted valuation of $42 trillion, based on its maximum supply of 21 million BTC.

| Bitcoin price | Valuation at maximum supply |
 --- |
| $30,000 | $630 billion |
| $40,000 | $840 billion |
| $2 million | $42 trillion |

At a fully diluted valuation of $42 trillion, Bitcoin would be worth roughly eight times Apple's market value, almost 10 times Nvidia's and more than 10 times Microsoft's. [...] I/O Fund sees Bitcoin reaching $2 million long term but warns a decline toward $30,000–$40,000 could come first.

 

Key Takeaways

 I/O Fund has maintained its $2 million Bitcoin target while warning of a potential decline toward $30,000–$40,000.
 Its bearish outlook depends on key price levels.
 Tom Lee has previously discussed BTC reaching $2 million, citing its potential to rival gold.

items.title: Can Bitcoin Bounce Back To $125,000? | Trefis
items.summary:
Strategy, the biggest corporate buyer, is stuck at its own line. Strategy owns about 850,000 Bitcoin at an average cost of about $75,456. Bitcoin’s Monday close, about $75,260 (Coinbase, midnight UTC), was just below that. Strategy used to raise money by selling shares at a premium and buying more coins; with that premium gone, its buying has slowed. We flagged that line on Nov 2 in MSTR Stock’s Real Risk: Bitcoin Below $75,446. A big buyer that has slowed is one less engine for a rebound. [...] | After the Nov 2022 low | Date | Bitcoin | From the low |
 ---  --- |
| The low | Nov 21, 2022 | $15,787 | n/a |
| One year on | Nov 21, 2023 | $35,814 | +127% |
| Start of 2024 | Jan 2, 2024 | $44,958 | +185% |
| Back to the old peak | Mar 4, 2024 | $68,330 | +333% |
| End of 2024 | Dec 31, 2024 | $93,429 | +492% |
| New peak | Oct 6, 2025 | $124,753 | +690% |

Trefis price data. Back to the 2021 peak in about 15 months from the low; nearly eight times the low at the 2025 peak. [...] That last column is the most important number in this piece. The timing held, about 17 to 18 months from halving to peak, three times running. But the gain fell from about 30 times, to under 8 times, to under 2 times. Measured from each winter low to the next peak it’s the same story: 109 times, then 21 times, then 8 times. Bitcoin is a far bigger asset now, and big assets don’t multiply like small ones. If you’re counting on a 2024-style rebound, count on the shrinking multiple too.
